defs.def: a person whose job is writing books, stories, articles, etc. 作家；作者；著者

ex.s: I never thought I could be a writer.
ex.t: 我从没想过自己能成为一名作家。

ex.t: 该项目将选出10名视觉艺术家和10名作家，创作将在多功能步道沿线的临时标牌上展出的作品。

ex.s: Not all great writers are great spellers.
ex.t: 并非所有伟大的作家都擅长拼写。

ex.s: Trost also wants to introduce local writers to local riders.
ex.t: 特罗斯特还想把当地作家介绍给当地乘客。

ex.s: It’s hard for writers because endings carry so much weight with readers.
ex.t: 对作家来说这很难，因为结局在读者心中分量太重。

ex.t: 为一位作家辩护。

ex.s: Too many writers try to get their drafts right the first time.
ex.t: 太多的作家 试图让他们的草稿 第一次。

ex.s: Many beginning writers don't leave enough space to revise.
ex.t: 许多初级作家没有留下足够的修改空间。

ex.s: He's a published writer.
ex.t: 他是一位已出版作品的作家。

ex.t: 我的编辑托尼也是一位作家，她编辑过几本历史书。

ex.s: Hundreds of scientists, writers and academics sounded a warning to humanity in an open letter published last December: Policymakers and the rest of us must engage openly with the risk of global collapse.
ex.t: 数百名科学家、作家和学者去年12月在发表的一封公开信中向人类发出警告：政策制定者和我们所有人都必须公开面对全球崩溃的风险。

ex.s: To remember a writer.
ex.t: 为了纪念一位作家。

ex.s: Become the next star reporter news writer, director or producer.
ex.t: 孩子们和他们的营友在经营我们自己的新闻站的各个方面时，将创作并主持每晚晚餐时向整个营地播出的广播节目。

ex.s: Become the next star reporter, news writer, director or producer.
ex.t: 成为下一代明星记者、新闻撰稿人、总监或制片人。

ex.s: What does the author call on other writers to do?
ex.t: 作者呼吁其他作家做什么？

ex.s: Among the writers of the plays in this collection, Paul Green, Susan Glaspell, Maxwell Anderson, Thornton Wilder, William Saroyan, and Tennessee Williams have all received Pulitzer Prizes for their contributions to the theater.
ex.t: 在本剧本集的作家中，保罗·格林、苏珊·格拉斯佩尔、麦克斯韦尔·安德森、桑顿·怀尔德、威廉·萨罗扬和田纳西·威廉姆斯都因其对戏剧的贡献而获得普利策奖。

ex.s: In 1870, when Dickens died, the world mourned him as its first professional writer and publisher, famous and beloved, who had led an explosion in both the publication of novels and their readership and whose characters — from Oliver Twist to Tiny Tim— were held up as moral touchstones.
ex.t: 1870年狄更斯去世时，世界哀悼这位首位职业作家和出版人，他声名显赫、深受爱戴，引领了小说出版与读者群的爆发式增长，其笔下人物——从奥利弗·崔斯特到小蒂姆——被视为道德试金石。

ex.s: No one will ever know what mix of talent, ambition, energy and luck made Dickens such a singular writer.
ex.t: 无人能知，是天赋、抱负、精力与运气的何种组合造就了如此独特的狄更斯。

ex.s: To remember a great writer.
ex.t: 为了纪念一位伟大的作家。

ex.s: Is the writer who wears a fedora more creative?
ex.t: 戴软呢帽的作家就更有创造力吗？

ex.s: How does the writer recommend CHRONOLOGICA to readers?
ex.t: 作者向读者推荐《CHRONOLOGICA》的方式是什么？

ex.s: Lisa: Looking back on my high school life, the most important advice I'd give is these wonderful words from the writer Maya Angelou, She said, "Be a rainbow in somebody else's cloud." So, give your friends a hand when they need it.
ex.t: 丽莎：回顾我的高中生活，我能给出的最重要的建议是作家玛雅·安杰卢这些精彩的话，她说："成为别人乌云中的一道彩虹。"所以，当朋友需要帮助时，伸出你的手。

ex.s: Henry, was a world-famous American short story writer.
ex.t: 亨利是世界著名的美国短篇小说作家。

ex.s: Background information Maya Angelou (1928-2014) was an American poet, writer and civil rights activist.
ex.t: 背景信息 Maya Angelou（1928-2014）是美国诗人、作家和民权活动家。

ex.s: Plato was a great thinker and writer.
ex.t: 柏拉图是一位伟大的思想家和作家。

ex.s: Tolkien (1892-1973) was an English writer, poet and university professor, best known as the author of some of the world’s most popular high-fantasy novels.
ex.t: 托尔金（1892-1973）是一位英国作家、诗人和大学教授，最以创作了全球最受欢迎的一些高阶奇幻小说而闻名。

ex.s: That’s why this issue (期) of Writer’s Digest aims to help you figure out how to write the best ending for whatever kind of writing you’re doing.
ex.t: 所以本期《作家文摘》旨在帮助你弄清楚如何为你正在写的任何类型的作品写出最好的结局。

ex.s: Azimi says study participants tended not to trust reviews where the writers expressed their feelings in a big way.
ex.t: Azimi说，研究参与者往往不相信那些作家们以很大方式表达其感情的评论。

ex.s: A lengthy, positive review, on the other hand, was regarded as suspicious, and participants tended to trust writers that kept their glowing reviews short.
ex.t: 另一方面，一条冗长而正面的评价被认为是可疑的，参与者倾向于信任那些保持他们热情洋溢的评论简短的作家。
